customManagers.description: Track the agg release pinned via the AGG_VERSION build arg
Track the Playwright MCP server. Both pins must move together: the Dockerfile derives the bundled Chromium from this version, and codex-config.toml must request the same one

packageRules.description: Automerge minor/patch/digest updates via GitHub auto-merge, so a PR lands as soon as it is mergeable rather than waiting for the next weekly Renovate run. Note that main currently has no branch protection, so there are no required status checks for auto-merge to wait on and these PRs merge without the CI build having run. Add validate-config and build as required checks on main to gate them
Take @playwright/mcp immediately. The image derives its Chromium from this pin and the build launches the browser, so holding the pin back only prolongs a mismatch with upstream
Group all GitHub Actions updates into one PR
